name: Run Manager (Alpha)
description: Start, stop and watch a project's long-running processes, such as dev servers. Each run target is a named command that runs in a terminal tab; agents can start it, read its log and stop it.
author: Nimbalyst

enablement.purpose: Run this project's run targets in terminal tabs, check whether their ports are in use, and read and write the run targets file (.nimbalyst/run.json).

panels.title: Runs
panels.tooltip: Start, stop and watch this project's long-running processes.

marketplace.tagline: Start, stop and watch a project's dev servers (alpha)
